name: m05-5.6-understand-linux
title: Lab 5.6, part 1 (and the 5.0 basics videos): get the lab, set it up, and follow a model's output into a web page, Markdown, SQL, a shell command and a real HTTP response before attacking it
before: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh -o ollama-install.sh && sh ollama-install.sh && rm -f ollama-install.sh
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now ollama || (setsid nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &)
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version && break; sleep 2; done

steps.label: Plan
steps.type: python3 explore.py plan "search my tickets for VPN"

steps.label: Page
steps.type: python3 explore.py page "search my tickets for VPN"

steps.label: Markdown
steps.type: python3 explore.py markdown 'See the **VPN guide**: [open it](https://it.example/vpn) ![status](https://status.example/vpn.png)'

steps.label: Real model
steps.type: python3 explore.py markdown --ollama "In 3 short Markdown steps, how do I reconnect my laptop to the office Wi-Fi?"

steps.label: Two commands
steps.type: python3 explore.py shell "vpn; echo hello from a second command"
